# Rubric before agent

`customer_support.heu.quality_assurance.rubric_before_agent` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> When QA scores and customer feedback persistently disagree, look at the rubric before you look at the agent.


## The heuristic

**When QA scores and customer feedback persistently disagree, look at the rubric before you look at the agent.**


_Why:_ A standing gap between what the rubric rewards and what customers report usually means the rubric has drifted into describing internal preference. Agents scoring well on a rubric customers do not recognise are doing what they were asked.
